description: Encodes text as base64, or decodes base64 back to text, e.g. for a Basic auth header or an API field that wants base64. Supports standard and URL-safe base64.
label: Base64

options.name: mode
options.label: Mode
options.info: Encode turns Text into base64, like the classic base64_encode expression. Decode turns base64 back into text, like base64_decode.

options.name: text
options.label: Text
options.info: Encode: any text, encoded as UTF-8. Decode: the base64 to decode; line breaks and missing = padding are fine. Decoding fails if the result is not text, e.g. a PDF or image.

options.name: alphabet
options.label: Alphabet
options.info: Standard: the usual base64, with = padding when encoding. URL-safe: for JWTs and URL parameters, encoded without padding. Check which one the other system uses.

options.name: result
options.label: Result
options.info: Encode: the base64 text. Decode: the decoded text. Empty Text gives an empty result.
